options.name: items
options.description: The items (up to 1,000,000; the total height must stay under the browser limit, about 17.9 million px in Firefox); only the visible ones are rendered.

options.name: renderItem
options.description: Content of one item; called whenever the item is rendered.

options.name: itemKey
options.description: Stable key per item, used by value. Default: the index.

options.name: itemText
options.description: Type-ahead text. Default: strings, numbers, or the item's label property.

options.name: itemHeight
options.description: Item height in pixels (the estimate with variableHeight). Default by density: 32, 40, or 48.

options.name: variableHeight
options.description: Measure every rendered item instead of a fixed height.

options.name: height
options.description: Block size of the scroll area as a CSS length, or null to fill the host.

options.name: selection
options.description: none renders a plain list; single and multiple render a listbox.

options.name: selectionFollowsFocus
options.description: Single selection: moving focus with the keyboard also selects.

options.name: isDisabled
options.description: Items that cannot be selected or focused.

options.name: empty
options.description: Shown instead of the list when there are no items (for example an Empty State host).

options.name: loadMore
options.description: Infinite scroll: called near the end; resolve after appending items with update({ items }).

options.name: hasMore
options.description: More items can be loaded (with loadMore).

options.name: loadMoreThreshold
options.description: Items from the end at which loading starts.

options.name: overscan
options.description: Items rendered beyond each edge of the visible area (0 to 100).

options.name: density
options.description: Default item height when itemHeight is not set.

properties.name: range
properties.description: The visible items { start, end } (end exclusive).

properties.name: activeIndex
properties.description: Index of the focusable item in a listbox, or -1.

methods.name: scrollToIndex
methods.description: Scroll so the item is visible (auto: only as far as needed).

methods.name: focusItem
methods.description: Focus an item of a listbox, scrolling it into view.

methods.name: getItemElement
methods.description: The rendered element of an item, or null.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Render the visible items again after item objects changed in place.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The user changed the selection: { value, index }.

events.name: aui-range-change
events.description: The visible range changed: { start, end, renderedStart, renderedEnd } (for lazy loading).

contentAreas.name: empty
contentAreas.description: Content shown when there are no items.

cssClasses.name: aui-virtual-list--selectable | --variable | --fill | --empty
cssClasses.description: Listbox mode, measured heights, fill the host, no items.

cssClasses.name: aui-virtual-list__item | __item--selected | __item--active
cssClasses.description: A rendered item (role=listitem or option), selected, and the focusable one.
